title: Finnvian Network
description: The Finnvian Network is a Earth map Minecraft SMP server!
body:
The Finnvian Network is a community-oriented Minecraft server where players play on a Earth-shaped map. This server uses Towny and copper ingots for it's currency. There's a map web page which showcases the servers' Earth world, player location and Towns.

![A map which shows player locations and changes to the world in your web browser.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8049908ae24cfd11cf5cd120a32aaf226882b34e.jpeg)
